notes: Cumulative Notes audit on stable v0.2.24. Rebuilds Notes to exactly six fields: Aliases, Tags, Mood Board, Aesthetic Tags, Color Palette, and Important Objects. Reuses the existing Aesthetic data key as Mood Board so saved moodboard/aesthetic notes are preserved. Removes obsolete Notes fields such as Quotes, Playlist, Inspirations, Voice Reference, character/reader knowledge notes, universe notes, Trivia, and Custom Fields from the Notes UI. Preserves Timeline, Story, Powers, updater fixes, separate user data, and both runnable/compressed core files. All internal per-file SHA-256 values were recomputed and verified, the compressed core matches the runnable core, and Windows PowerShell parsing passed before publish.
